source: Vivino via Apify (mrbridge/vivino-powerful-scraper), red wines, US market, USD, July 2026
method: Stratified sample across price bands (0-20, 21+, 40-80, 80-200, 200-2000), deduped by wineId, minRating 2.5, sorted by ratings_count
samplingBias: Vivino community ratings compress toward 3.4-4.5; popular/expensive wines attract more and higher ratings. Sample favours popular wines (sorted by ratings_count).
